title: Forward a message
summary: Sends a copy of a sent message to one or more chats of the same account (bipe-chat/bipe#664): text, photo, video, file, voice message and location. Media keeps its source on the server and is not downloaded or uploaded again.

chats.description: The joined chats of the account (Client.rooms with membership joined, spaces left out), by name, the chat of the message included. Default chosen (bipe-chat/bipe#664): by name, because the timeline screen has no chat list order and the search finds a chat fast. mz can overrule.

query.description: Filters chats by name, ignoring case and accents.

picked.description: At most 5. A sixth pick shows bipe_forward_limit with the limit and is not added.

isSending.description: true while the copies go out; the picker takes no input.

open.effect: Opens the picker as a sheet over chat-timeline, titled bipe_forward_title.

toggle.effect: Adds or removes the chat from picked. A picked chat shows a check mark, not only a colour.

send.effect: The button bipe_forward_action, off while picked is empty. For each picked chat: Room.timeline, then Timeline.send with messageEventContentNew of the original MessageContent.msgType (no reply, no thread, no mentions). Then closes and shows bipe_forward_done. A chat whose send failed shows bipe_forward_failed with its name; the others stay sent.

notes: Which messages: a sent message (it has an event ID) of kind message (MsgLikeKind.message). Stickers, polls, undecryptable and deleted messages have no forward. Default chosen (bipe-chat/bipe#664): polls are not forwarded, because a copied poll would collect votes in another chat. mz can overrule.
Default chosen (bipe-chat/bipe#664): at most 5 chats per forward, because more is a broadcast. mz can overrule.
The copy carries no label that says it was forwarded. The voice-note source labels are bipe-chat/bipe#83.
Selection mode (forward or delete several messages at once) is a second step of bipe-chat/bipe#664.
